//Purpose: Development-only overrides for Orthanc. Mounted alongside orthanc.json by docker-compose.dev.yml and NEVER by the production stack. Named to sort last: Orthanc merges every JSON file in /etc/orthanc, and the last value read wins.
//Authentication: Off locally so the OHIF proxy can reach DICOMweb without a credential. Safe here because the dev stack runs on a developer's machine; the production stack keeps authentication on and injects a credential at the proxy.
//Storage: A developer's sample data is small, and evicting it mid-session would be confusing.
//Stability: Studies are considered stable quickly so seeded data is queryable straight after upload instead of a minute later.
